name: 2 for $85 Piercing Special
headline: 2 for $85 on any piercing
description: Work of Art is running a 2-for-$85 piercing special on eligible placements. Book or text ahead to confirm same-day availability, anatomy fit, and piercer schedule before heading in.
eligiblePiercings: ear piercings (lobe, helix, conch, tragus, daith, industrial, and ear curation)
most body piercings except tongue and lip placements
jewelryTerms: Starter jewelry is included for both piercings; upgrades or anatomy-specific fit changes are confirmed during the consult.
exclusions: Not valid on tongue or lip piercings (including labret, philtrum, snake bites, and similar oral/lip placements). Offer depends on anatomy, applicable age policy, healing history, piercer availability, and jewelry fit.
altText: Curated helix, tragus, and lobe piercings at Work of Art Tattoo and Piercing in Las Vegas
